purpose: Teach: 村井/多田/若林/上原/河合/石橋/西口/望月

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の村井部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new division director, Murai.
lines.style: Formal command tone. Crisp, decisive opening. No hesitation. The weight of leadership in the brevity. Eyes steady on the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の多田課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the travel schedule for Tada, our sales manager.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Businesslike cadence, moving from acknowledgment straight into action. Efficient, no flourish. Slight nod as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の若林主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the project to Wakabayashi, our technical lead.
lines.style: Direct instruction, mid-register. The tone of someone delegating with confidence. Measured pace. No question mark in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の上原様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll adopt the strategy from Uehara in PR.
lines.style: Affirming quickly. Processing and moving forward in one breath. Calm, capable tone. The voice of someone who executes without lag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の河合様にご助言を仰げ
lines.style: Instruction delivered with slight deference. Respectful weight on the name. Measured, not rushed. The acknowledgment of someone's seniority built into the phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取締役の石橋様の出張をご手配します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the travel for Director Ishibashi.
lines.style: Compact confirmation. The same efficient rhythm as before. Moving into action mode. Professional, unadorned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外担当の西口部長に欧州市場の調査を任せろ
lines.en: Put Nishiguchi, our overseas division director, on the European market research.
lines.style: Clear delegation. Steady, unhurried pace. The tone of assigning responsibility to someone trusted. Slight emphasis on the scope of the task.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の望月様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask Legal—Mochizuki—to review the contracts.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Same efficient register, bringing the sequence to close. Calm finality. The last piece sliding into place.
